title: Campylobacter jejuni Culture Method
author: Sara D. Lawhon
materials: Campylobacter jejuni on Campy-Cefex agar. Figure

steps.title: Store samples refrigerated
steps.instruction: Keep fecal samples at 4 °C until processing.

steps.title: Process within 72 h
steps.instruction: Begin processing each sample no later than 72 h after receipt.

steps.title: Weigh feces
steps.instruction: Weigh 8 g of feces (minimum 2 g) into a 50 mL conical tube; record the exact weight.

steps.title: Prepare feces‑PBS slurry
steps.instruction: Add 32 mL of 1X PBS (Life Technologies Catalog #10010-023) to the tube to achieve a 1:4 feces‑to‑PBS ratio (e.g., 2 g feces with 8 mL PBS); mix to form a slurry.

steps.title: Inoculate agar plates
steps.instruction: Using a sterile polyester‑tipped swab, transfer a small amount of slurry onto the first quadrant of an mCCDA‑CAT plate and a Campy‑Cefex plate; streak for isolation. Include positive controls (ATCC 33291, 33292, or 33560) and a negative control (ATCC 29522 E. coli) on separate plates.

steps.title: Incubate primary plates
steps.instruction: Place the inoculated plates in a gas‑tight canister with an AnaeroPack‑MicroAero sachet (Thermo Fisher Catalog #R681005); incubate at 42 °C ± 2 °C for 48 h. Record the date and time the plates are placed in the incubator.

steps.title: Record removal time
steps.instruction: After 48 h, remove the plates from the incubator and record the date and time of removal.

steps.title: Examine plates for colonies
steps.instruction: Inspect mCCDA‑CAT and Campy‑Cefex plates for suspect colonies: watery appearance, orangish/tan color on Campy‑Cefex, or white/clear colonies on mCCDA‑CAT.

steps.title: Subculture suspect colonies
steps.instruction: Select up to four suspect colonies and streak each onto blood agar plates (trypticase soy agar with 5 % sheep blood, BD Catalog #221261).

steps.title: Incubate subculture plates
steps.instruction: Place the blood‑agar plates in a gas‑tight canister with a fresh AnaeroPack‑MicroAero sachet; incubate at 42 °C ± 2 °C for 48 h. Record the date and time the plates are placed in the incubator.

steps.title: Record subculture removal
steps.instruction: After 48 h, remove the subculture plates and record the date and time of removal.

steps.title: Confirm colony identity
steps.instruction: Identify the colonies as Campylobacter spp. using one or more of the following: (i) MALDI‑TOF (Bruker Biotyper) directly or after subculture; (ii) C. jejuni gyrA PCR; (iii) biochemical tests – Gram stain, catalase test with 3 % H₂O₂, oxidase test using BD oxidase reagent Catalog #261181. Note that C. jejuni is Gram‑negative, curved, catalase‑positive, oxidase‑positive; subsp. doylei may have variable catalase activity.

steps.title: Decontaminate work area
steps.instruction: Wipe down sample tubes and gloves with 10 % bleach solution to minimize cross‑contamination.
